import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_centered_bound (x : ℝ) (h₀ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10) : (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 ≤ 81 := by
  have h₁ : (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 ≤ 81 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 9), sq_nonneg (x + 1), sq_nonneg (x - 3 / 2),
      sq_nonneg (x - 7 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x - 1 / 2)]
  exact h₁

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_centered_bound (x : ℝ) (h₀ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10) : (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 ≤ 81 := by
  have h₁ : (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 ≤ 81 := by
    have h₂ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10 := h₀
    have h₃ : (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 ≤ 81 := by
      
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x - 1), sq_nonneg (x + 1),
        sq_nonneg (x - 2), sq_nonneg (x - 4), sq_nonneg (x + 4), sq_nonneg (x - 3),
        sq_nonneg (x + 3), sq_nonneg (x - 6), sq_nonneg (x + 6)]
    exact h₃
  exact h₁
